trace.notes: Normalized the input as a zbMATH bibliographic resolver URL for record 1621449. The exact work was identified as Madeleine Pascal, Some Open Problems in Dynamic Analysis of Flexible Multibody Systems, Multibody System Dynamics 5, 315-334 (2001), DOI 10.1023/A:1011427015995.

Failure mode: paywalled_or_restricted. The Springer DOI landing page was the exact same work but exposed only the title, abstract, references, and subscription or purchase prompts rather than readable full text.

Failure mode: metadata_only for zbMATH and secondary resolver pages. Exact-title, DOI, and PDF searches returned the Springer preview, zbMATH author metadata, and citing or related papers, but no readable exact-work PDF or full HTML article.

No candidates were accepted because the only visible technical source text was an abstract-level summary. The source adequacy gate forbids extracting questions from abstracts, citation metadata, link labels, or search snippets when full problem statements are not visible.
